news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.3% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.2x net interest cover). news.title: Pvp Ventures Limited Appoints Dileep Badey as the Whole Time Director
news.body: PVP Ventures Limited submitted the voting results along with the Scrutinizer’s Report in respect of the Extra-Ordinary General Meeting of the company convened and held on March 6, 2026 through Video Conferencing /Other Audio-Visual Means. The company approved the appointment of Mr. Dileep Badey as the whole time director.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.14 loss per share (vs ₹0.02 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.14 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.02 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹170.9m (up ₹146.1m from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹35.4m (loss widened ₹30.9m from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 137 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
